items.question: Under Dubai's Integrated Energy Strategy 2030, what percentage of generating capacity is targeted to come from natural gas by 2030?
items.fact: Integrated Energy Strategy 2030 targets 71 per cent natural gas capacity

items.question: Under Dubai's Integrated Energy Strategy 2030, what percentage of generating capacity is targeted to come from solar facilities by 2030?
items.fact: Integrated Energy Strategy 2030 targets 5 per cent solar capacity
